capabilities: Watch a folder for new markdown files at a configurable interval
Import Claude chat exports into the vault preserving subdirectory structure
Delete source files and empty directories after successful import
Trigger manual imports via a command or ribbon icon
Configure watch folder, vault destination, and notifications in settings
extras: Works standalone with any .md files dropped in the watch folder, not only Claude exports; duplicate files in the vault are skipped rather than updated.
motivation: Created for use with the Claude to Obsidian project, to pair with its Chrome extension for exporting chats.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to watch an external folder and import chat exports saved there into the vault automatically.

relations.evidence: This plugin is designed to work with the Claude to Obsidian Chrome extension

summary: Folder-watching importer that automatically pulls Claude chat export markdown files from a watched folder into a vault folder.
